resource_directories.references: Domain knowledge, formats and writing guidance.
resource_directories.scripts: Executable mechanics, dependencies and modules grouped by responsibility.
resource_directories.evals: Behavioral cases, fixtures, rubrics and assessment.

principles: One installable skill at the repository root; no nested duplicate SKILL.md.
The repository is the distributable artifact; no dist directory or distribution manifest.
Use only folders the domain needs. Each rule and component has one owner.
Keep internal authoring records and run snapshots outside the repository.
Required structure is mechanical; domain fit and meaning also need source-grounded review.
Repository work rules live in AGENTS.md; CLAUDE.md imports them. Run impacted tests while editing and obtain explicit approval before every push.
